• Proven ability to lead the development of software development projects.
• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems or similar

Overview:

The Revenue Policy Analyst is responsible for the development of revenue policy and strategy within the newly established Revenue Strategy Unit (RS). This is a great opportunity for team members currently working within Local Health Networks (LHNs) to contribute to system-wide policy development and gain experience within the Department. 

The unit supports and manages key policy initiatives designed to support the optimisation of revenue outcomes for public health services. The unit's purpose is to provide system leadership, though policy and guidance to revenue-based teams working across the Local Health Networks, who are responsible for optimising revenue outcomes and meeting revenue compliance requirements. It achieves this through:

The development and maintenance of policies and guidelines (policy and governance).

Strategy, education, and business reform across all patient revenue streams.

The provision of a level 2 helpdesk, supporting Local Health Networks to get policy and practice right every time.

Commonwealth department and jurisdictional consultation and engagement on system wide issues-matters.

Periodic and ad hoc Revenue Compliance reviews.

The Revenue Policy Analyst will be involved in funding matters and audits and the provision of expert policy related advice to Local Health Networks (LHNs) to ensure that SA Health policies are implemented and adhered to.

About Codafication
Codafication is a tech company located just off James Street in Brisbane’s Fortitude Valley. We have developed globally recognised solutions for the insurance and construction industries.  Our mission is to pioneer new ways to make the world simpler - and we are building solutions that streamline experiences for our customers making them more efficient and cost-effective. With deep domain knowledge and client partnerships across the trillion-dollar global insurance and construction industries, we are scaling our products and utilisation across Australia, New Zealand and into North America. 
Check us out at Codafication.com 
About the Role
No day is the same as a Customer Success Officer at Codafication! To succeed in this role you will be flexible in your daily activities, enjoy problem-solving and looking for new ways to help customers achieve success using Codafication’s tools. 

As the voice of our customers, you will play an important role in our business working closely with the Project Management, Business Analyst and Software Engineering teams to manage different projects to success. You will provide clear and empathetic customer service and technical support ensuring clients experience success with Codafication’s product offerings.

Your day-to-day duties will include: 

•	Delivering onboarding, training, coaching, and mentoring for customers
•	Building and maintaining strong business relationships with customers
•	Providing frontline support to customers and management of Jira support tickets
•	Building and maintaining high quality customer-facing materials and repositories (e.g. knowledge base library, FAQs, training packages)
•	Providing feedback, support, and updates to internal stakeholders to optimise the customer experience
•	Conducting workshops, demonstrations, training, and reviews of products with customers
•	Driving adoption and retention, while identifying opportunities for account growth and additional product placement


About you
As our successful candidate, you will demonstrate;
•	At least 3 years of relevant work experience
•	Technical experience would be advantageous
•	Excellent written and verbal skills 
•	Love for problem solving and thrive in a dynamic and fast paced environment
•	Ability to win trust and drive relationships to ensure best outcomes for customers and the business
•	Excellent resource management and planning skills
•	Highly motivated with a desire to learn and grow
•	Ability to resolve customer complaints, enquiries, and conduct basic troubleshooting quickly and efficiently

Life at Coda
•	Brand new Fortitude Valley Office bordering James Street Precinct
•	Quarterly staff functions - Celebrate our success as a team
•	Be recognised and rewarded for your achievements
•	Revitalise Days + Volunteer Leave giving you up to 4 extra leave days a year to do what you love
•	Regular 1-2-1 time with your leader to accelerate your career
•	Genuine career progression
•	Hybrid working environment to promote genuine work-life balance

If you want to be part of a winning team and this role suits you to a tee, I would love to hear from you. We do have an immediate start available however happy to wait for the right person given notice periods. 

Salary offered is $75k to $85k

Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled Software and Applications Programmer to design, build, test and maintain high-quality software solutions that support business operations and digital transformation initiatives. This role is suited to a technically strong professional who enjoys problem-solving, working across systems, and contributing to the full software development lifecycle. You will collaborate closely with stakeholders to translate requirements into reliable, scalable applications.
Key Responsibilities
Analyse business and system requirements to design effective software and application solutions.
Develop, test and maintain application code in line with defined technical specifications and quality standards.
Identify system limitations, performance issues and process inefficiencies, recommending practical improvements.
Debug, diagnose and resolve application defects within established testing and release frameworks.
Collaborate with analysts, engineers and stakeholders to ensure solutions align with functional and technical needs.
Produce and maintain technical documentation, including system designs, operational guides and user instructions.
Support integration of applications with existing platforms, databases and third-party services.
Contribute to software upgrades, enhancements and version control activities.
Apply secure coding practices and ensure compliance with organisational and regulatory standards.
Provide technical input into solution proposals, including effort estimation, feasibility and cost considerations.
Required Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related field.
Proven experience in software or application development across commercial or enterprise environments.
Strong programming skills in one or more modern languages (e.g. Java, C#, Python, JavaScript or similar).
Experience with application testing, debugging and troubleshooting methodologies.
Understanding of system design principles, APIs, databases and software architecture concepts.
Ability to interpret technical specifications and translate them into working solutions.
Strong analytical, documentation and communication skills.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively within cross-functional teams.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience working in Agile or DevOps environments.
Exposure to cloud platforms, containerisation or microservices architectures.
Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, version control systems and automated testing tools.
Relevant industry certifications or ongoing professional development in software technologies.
Why Join Us?
Work on meaningful software projects that support real-world business outcomes.
Supportive and collaborative team culture with opportunities for technical growth.
Exposure to diverse technologies, systems and problem domains.
Long-term role with stability and career progression opportunities.
Job Details
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super
